lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Shopping. Peppa and George are going shopping. Peppa and George like shopping.
lines.zh: 购物。佩奇和乔治要去购物。佩奇和乔治喜欢购物。

lines.en: George loves sitting in the trolley. So does Peppa! Daddy, can I sit in the trolley, too? You're too big for the trolley, Peppa! But you can help with the shopping. Oh, goody!
lines.zh: 乔治喜欢坐在购物车里。佩奇也想！爸爸，我也能坐购物车吗？佩奇，你太大了，坐不下啦！不过你可以帮忙买东西。哦，太好啦！

lines.en: We've got four things on the list: tomatoes, spaghetti, onions and fruit. I'll find it all! This way! Peppa and George love shopping!
lines.zh: 清单上有四样东西：西红柿、意大利面、洋葱和水果。我全都能找到！这边走！佩奇和乔治喜欢购物！

lines.en: Peppa, first we need tomatoes. I can see them! I can see them!
lines.zh: 佩奇，首先我们需要西红柿。我看见啦！我看见啦！

lines.en: Here are the tomatoes, Mummy! Well done, Peppa! One, two, three, four! Now put them in the trolley!
lines.zh: 妈妈，西红柿在这儿！干得好，佩奇！一、二、三、四个！现在把它们放进购物车里！

lines.en: I found the tomatoes! Tomatoes! Well done, Peppa. Tomatoes, that's one thing off the list! What's next on the list?
lines.zh: 我找到西红柿啦！西红柿！干得好，佩奇。西红柿，清单上划掉一样啦！清单上下一样是什么？

lines.en: Spaghetti! Spaghetti? That's right, George, but it's called spaghetti! Spaghetti! Spaghetti is Peppa and George's favourite food.
lines.zh: 意大利面！意大利面？没错，乔治，不过它叫意大利面！意大利面！意大利面是佩奇和乔治最喜欢的食物。

lines.en: I wonder where the spaghetti is. I can see it! This way!
lines.zh: 不知道意大利面在哪儿呢。我看见啦！这边走！

lines.en: Spaghetti! Look, Mummy, here's the spaghetti! Well done, Peppa! Let's put the spaghetti in the trolley.
lines.zh: 意大利面！妈妈你看，意大利面在这儿！干得好，佩奇！我们把意大利面放进购物车吧。

lines.en: Yes, Mummy! Pagetti! George, it's called spaghetti!
lines.zh: 好的，妈妈！意面！乔治，它叫意大利面！

lines.en: Petti! What's next on the list, Peppa? Crisps! Crisps are not on the list! We have plenty of crisps at home, Peppa. Have another guess! Hmm, I just can't remember!
lines.zh: 面！佩奇，清单上下一样是什么？薯片！薯片不在清单上！佩奇，家里薯片多着呢。再猜一次！嗯，我记不起来了！

lines.en: Can you remember, George? Dinosaur! Dinosaur? George, there aren't any dinosaurs in the supermarket!
lines.zh: 乔治，你还记得吗？恐龙！恐龙？乔治，超市里没有恐龙！

lines.en: No, George, the next thing on the list is onions!
lines.zh: 不对，乔治，清单上的下一样是洋葱！

lines.en: Onions! I remember now! Here they are! Well done! One, two, three, four onions!
lines.zh: 洋葱！我现在想起来了！在这儿呢！干得好！一、二、三、四个洋葱！

lines.en: Very good, that's nearly everything on our list! There's one last thing on the list! A plant? Is that on the list? Oh, no, George, the last thing on the list is fruit.
lines.zh: 很好，清单上的东西差不多齐了！清单上还有最后一样！一株植物？那在清单上吗？哦，不对，乔治，最后一样是水果。

lines.en: Oh, never mind, George, you can choose the fruit! Where is the fruit? Over there! There are apples and oranges and bananas and a very big melon. What fruit shall we have, George? Apples? Oranges? Bananas? A melon!
lines.zh: 哦，没关系，乔治，水果让你来挑！水果在哪儿呢？在那边！有苹果、橙子、香蕉，还有一个特别大的西瓜。乔治，我们要哪种水果呢？苹果？橙子？香蕉？西瓜！

lines.en: This is the checkout, where all the food is paid for. Tomatoes, spaghetti, onions, melon.
lines.zh: 这里是收银台，所有食物都在这儿付钱。西红柿、意大利面、洋葱、西瓜。

lines.en: Chocolate cake! Chocolate cake! Chocolate cake? Is that on the list? Peppa, did you put the chocolate cake in the trolley? No, Mummy! George, did you put the chocolate cake in the trolley? No! Well, I didn't put it in! Then who did?
lines.zh: 巧克力蛋糕！巧克力蛋糕！巧克力蛋糕？那在清单上吗？佩奇，是你把巧克力蛋糕放进购物车的吗？不是我，妈妈！乔治，是你放的吗？不是！那也不是我放的！那是谁放的呢？

lines.en: Um, I thought it might be nice for pudding! Daddy Pig! Naughty Daddy! Sorry, it just looked so delicious! It does look rather yummy! Oh, let's pretend it was on the list!
lines.zh: 呃，我觉得拿它当饭后甜点应该不错！猪爸爸！调皮的爸爸！对不起，它看起来实在太好吃了！它确实看起来相当诱人！哦，那我们就假装它在清单上吧！

lines.en: Chocolate cake! Great!
lines.zh: 巧克力蛋糕！太棒啦！
